meta.description: AI Factory - Automated AI image and video creation studio for Windows and macOS

hero.title: AI Studio for images & videos
hero.sub: AI Factory turns your ideas into high-quality images and videos in seconds. No design skills required. Runs right on your machine.

features.title: Powerful features
features.sub: Everything you need to create professional AI content

f1.title: 1,000 images + videos/hour
f1.desc: High-speed batch processing — 1,000 images and videos per hour, fully automated without supervision.

f2.title: Character sync
f2.desc: Keep faces and character styles consistent across hundreds of images and videos.

f3.title: Scene sync
f3.desc: Replicate exact backgrounds, lighting, and environments across your entire batch.

f4.title: Voice sync
f4.desc: Clone and sync AI voiceovers for consistent narration across your entire video series.

f5.title: No Google account needed
f5.desc: No need to log in with a Google account. Just download the app and use it straight away.

how.title: Get started in 3 steps
how.sub: So simple anyone can do it

s1.title: Download & Install
s1.desc: Get the installer for Windows or macOS. Run it and follow the wizard.

s2.title: Enter your idea
s2.desc: Pick a template or describe what you want to create.

s3.title: Export & use
s3.desc: Get high-quality images or videos saved straight to your machine.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. The current version is completely free with no limit on the number of images or videos generated.
faq.q2: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.a2: Only for the first model download. After that, you can use it fully offline.
faq.q3: Can I use the generated content commercially?
faq.a3: Yes. You own all content you create and can use it for any commercial purpose.
faq.q4: Will it run on a low-end machine?
faq.a4: It can run, but will be slower. A dedicated GPU is recommended for the best experience.
faq.a5: Absolutely. All processing happens on your machine — no data is sent to any server.
